u0: The agent has not yet made progress on the mission: the key has not been acquired, the door is closed, and the target box has not been picked up. From this starting point the agent must obtain the matching key, then open the door, then pick up the designated box in the other room. Attempting to open the door or pick up the box without first holding the key would fail the mission irrecoverably.
u1: A mandatory requirement has been violated, so successful completion is no longer possible. This occurs if the door was opened or the box picked up before the key was acquired, or if the box was taken before the door was opened. The episode is charged a hard failure penalty and the task cannot be recovered.
u2: The agent is now carrying the matching key while the door is still closed and the box has not been picked up. The next objective is to open the locked door with the key in hand, then later drop the key and pick up the designated box in the other room. Picking up the box before opening the door would fail the mission.
u3: The agent has opened the door and still holds the key, with the target box not yet picked up. The remaining objective is to drop the key and pick up the designated box in the other room; picking up the box now satisfies all requirements. Taking any other step other than acquiring the box leaves progress where it is.
u4: All requirements are satisfied: the matching key was acquired, the door was opened, and the designated box has been picked up, ending the episode successfully. No further objectives remain.
